WITH ckd_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (443612, 443611)
), outpatient_measurements AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_concept_id, m.measurement_source_value
  FROM omop.measurement m
  JOIN ckd_patients cp ON cp.person_id = m.person_id
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id = m.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9202, 581477, 32253)
    AND m.measurement_concept_id <> 0
)
SELECT TOP 25
  m.measurement_concept_id,
  c.concept_name AS lab_name,
  c.vocabulary_id,
  c.concept_code,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM outpatient_measurements m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n_orders DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ckd_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (443612, 443611)
), outpatient_labs AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_concept_id
  FROM omop.measurement m
  JOIN ckd_patients cp ON cp.person_id = m.person_id
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id = m.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9202, 581477, 32253)
    AND m.measurement_concept_id <> 0
    AND c.vocabulary_id = 'LOINC'
    AND (
      c.concept_name LIKE '%Serum or Plasma%'
      OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Blood%'
      OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Urine%'
      OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Plasma%'
      OR c.concept_name LIKE '%Serum%'
    )
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Blood pressure%'
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Heart rate%'
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Respiratory rate%'
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Body temperature%'
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Body weight%'
    AND c.concept_name NOT LIKE '%Oxygen saturation%'
)
SELECT TOP 25
  l.measurement_concept_id,
  c.concept_name AS lab_name,
  c.concept_code AS loinc,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM outpatient_labs l
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = l.measurement_concept_id
GROUP BY l.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n_orders DESC;

  JOIN ckd_patients cp ON cp.person_id = m.person_id
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id = m.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9202, 581477, 32253)
    AND m.measurement_concept_id <> 0
)
SELECT TOP 60
  m.measurement_concept_id,
  c.concept_name AS measurement_name,
  c.vocabulary_id,
  c.concept_code,
  COUNT_BIG(*) AS n_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM outpatient_measurements m
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code
ORDER BY n_orders DESC;
